note: The tuning values the simulation decides by (ADR-016, decision 4). Each is a decimal string under a key named with its unit, as the design states it. Tools/BakeContent.py --server converts each exactly, through fractions.Fraction, into the simulation's unit and writes it into ServerData's RULE section under the converted key: meters to voxels and seconds to ticks, each of which must come out whole, and speeds and accelerations to Core::Fixed per tick, floored once. Tools/CheckAssets.py fails a value that does not convert. The values are the owner's of 2026-11-01 (GameDesign.md, M2's values), by item: spans 14; the warning 4; the fall's gravity 5; the shot and its craters 12; loose material 9; the navigation classes 10, with cavalry's and machines' speeds the owner's of the same day after M2's report. The work budgets, slumpVoxelsPerTick among them, are the implementer's, Proposed until M2-G2 measures the tick against its 25 ms (item 13); the owner decided slump's and the paths' on closing M2. queryWorkPerTick is M3's, Proposed until M3-G3 measures it (GameDesign.md, M3's values, item 10). The class speeds of cavalry and machines left for Units.json, where each kind has its own, and footSpeedMetersPerSecond stays for the collapse's warning (ADR-023, decision 1). M4's values (GameDesign.md, M4's values), by item: the shot's stone 5; the arrow and elevation 7, its step's 15 % being ADR-023's damage formula's; the crush of a shot, a collapse and a drop 8; the ram 9; the garrison's healing 10; repair and its lock 11; the passage attack 13; deploying and packing 17; the control 19, its structures' hit points in Structures.json; the wait before a squad searches again is ADR-022's, the reveal ADR-025's at item 14's 2 s, and the commanders' cadence and work ADR-027's at item 18's 0.5 s and item 27's 32 units, Proposed until M4-J4 measures them.
